title: Skyworth SW-22SA (device SW6H, MediaTek, ~1.9 GB RAM), Android TV 14 (API 34), build UTT1.250517.001
notes:
Skyworth SW-22SA (device SW6H, MediaTek, ~1.9 GB RAM), Android TV 14 (API 34), build UTT1.250517.001
Google TV home: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (owns HOME; setupwraith RecoveryActivity also claims it).
Live TV / inputs: com.smartdevice.livetv (+ overlay_SANLUX), com.mediatek.tvinput, com.mediatek.tv.service.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/skyworth-sw-22sa/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/skyworth-sw-22sa/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Disabled from the factory, so not listed (restore.sh would turn them ON):
com.smartdevice.myapp.

Quirks on this firmware, checked on the TV 2026-10-21:
- Port 5555 goes flaky: opens when USB debugging is switched, may close again on its own, and
the adb client can go "offline" mid-session; reconnect with `adb connect <ip>:5555`.
The stock adb client (platform-tools 37.0.1) authenticates reliably; delete tools/adbkey to let
tools/tv.py fall back to ~/.android/adbkey when the TV already trusts that key.
- Forget + re-join Wi-Fi changes the TV's DHCP address; rediscover it (Google Cast port 8008
answers before ADB does).
- `adb exec-out screencap -p` is corrupted by an adbd stdout wrapper ("Init wrapper sys mutex
successful", LF->CRLF). Screenshots must go screencap to a file + `adb pull`.
- No dedicated updater package; com.smartdevice.aftersale can push APKs on boot, so it is disabled.

Kept on purpose: com.smartdevice.factory, com.smartdevice.dailyshortcut (quick menu),
com.smartdevice.duplebluetooth + com.smartdevice.bleconnectservice (BLE remote pairing),
com.smartdevice.livetv + overlay_SANLUX (Live TV), com.mediatek.tvinput / tv.service /
tv.globalkeyoverlay (HDMI + hot keys), com.dolby.android.audio.service,
com.google.android.apps.mediashell (Chromecast, by choice), com.google.android.katniss +
com.google.android.tv.assistant (Assistant, by choice), com.google.android.youtube.tv,
com.netflix.ninja, com.tianci.localmedia, Play Store + Play Services, all system/Google core.
